R 4.4.3 on aarch64-apple-darwin20; RAM 24 GB (17 GB free)

files.analysis.R:
library(gptr)

gptr("cluster the cells and show me the markers for the three largest clusters")
files.AGENTS.md:
# AGENTS.md
- Style: = for assignment, |> for pipes, snake_case.
- Single-cell data: Seurat v5; keep pbmc as the main object.

objects.pbmc: {gptr::gptr_doc(file.path(getwd(), 'analysis.R')); data.frame(cell = sprintf('c%04d', 1:600), nCount_RNA = 1200 + (1:600) %% 97, percent.mt = round(1 + ((1:600) %% 13) / 2, 1), cluster = rep(0:4, 120))}

turns.prompt: cluster the cells and show me the markers for the three largest clusters

calls.name: r

input.code:
pbmc = FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc = FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.8)
markers = FindAllMarkers(subset(pbmc, idents = 0:2), only.pos = TRUE)
nrow(markers)
input.note: resolution 0.8 chosen because 0.4 merged the two monocyte groups.
